meta.title: Elian Bustamante | Software development and landscape photography
meta.description: Elian Bustamante's portfolio: software projects (bots, data and web) and landscape photography.

hero.subtitle: Software development and landscape photography, from Chile.
hero.description: I trained in Informatics Engineering at Universidad de La Frontera. Here are my code projects and a selection of my photos.

gamesDealTracker.name: Games Deal Tracker
gamesDealTracker.description: Tracks Steam and Epic Games Store deals: discounts, all-time lows and weekly free games.

priceAlertBot.name: Price Alert Bot
priceAlertBot.description: Personal-use bot that sends WhatsApp price alerts from Google Shopping in Chile and the US, without a server, on GitHub Actions.

aiMemoryAssistant.name: AI Memory Assistant
aiMemoryAssistant.description: AI assistant with long-term memory: stores chat history in a vector database and retrieves context from past conversations.

photography.title: Photography
photography.intro: A selection of photographs of autumn and winter in Araucanía, plus waterfalls and a total lunar eclipse.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I live in Chile and trained in Informatics Engineering at Universidad de La Frontera. I have under two years of professional experience, split between internships and a short period of formal employment.
about.p2: I mostly work with Python, JavaScript and databases. I like building tools that solve concrete problems, like the bots in this portfolio.
about.p3: Outside of code I shoot landscape photography. The gallery on this page is a selection.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Have an opportunity or want to chat? Write to me.
